title: Fix rejected drain PR #168 (agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-73-1794530672)
description:
Drain PR #168 (branch `agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-73-1794530672`) was NOT merged by pr-auto-review (llm-rejected).
Repair it ON THE EXISTING BRANCH — do NOT create a new branch or a second PR:
1. `git fetch origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-73-1794530672 && git checkout agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-73-1794530672`
2. Address EVERY reason below.
3. Run `npm test` until green.
4. Commit and `git push origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-73-1794530672` — the reviewer re-reviews at the new SHA.

## Rejection reasons (verbatim)
- [major] scope creep: defeat-allowlist.json includes files that weren't scanned in this task — the PR description says 'pre-populated with all existing repo findings' but this should be done in a separate inventory task, not bundled with the validation logic
- [major] fragile implementation: four-layer-validate.mjs line 625-642 — the advisory scan runs before TS availability check but uses scanFunctionMetrics which may not exist if TS is unavailable, creating a potential runtime error
- [minor] inconsistent output: four-layer-validate.mjs line 656-657 — advisory findings are shown with different formatting when TS is unavailable vs available, creating inconsistent user experience
